tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Krane's free plan and Krane Pro: what each includes, the US monthly and yearly prices, and billing terms.

tools.name: check_feature
tools.description: Whether Krane does something, e.g. "Salesforce sync", "offline", "badge scanning", "Japanese cards", "Android". Returns yes (free plan), pro (Krane Pro), partial or no, with a one-paragraph answer and a page.

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Krane next to Blinq, CamCard, Covve, Haystack, HiHello or Popl: when to pick which, and a row-by-row table where each rival value has the URL of the rival's own page it was read from.

tools.name: get_download_link
tools.description: The App Store link for Krane, the devices it runs on and the iOS version it needs.

tools.name: contact_request
tools.description: Emails a question to Krane's founder, who answers by email. Use only when your user asked to contact Krane and agreed to share the email address and message you send; set user_consent to true to confirm that. Send nothing your user didn't approve.

tools.name: request_scan_access
tools.description: Issues an access token for scan_business_card, good for 3 free reads. Call it once, before the first scan. tools.name: scan_business_card
tools.description: Reads one photo of a paper business card and returns the contact: name, company, job title, phones, emails, websites, address and social handles, in the script printed on the card. findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "scan_business_card" references sensitive artifacts (access_token). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Reads one photo of a paper business card and returns the contact: name, company, job title, phones, emails, websites, address and social handles, in the script …

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: compare, scan_business_card · Private data: contact_request, request_scan_access, scan_business_card · Public sink: contact_request, request_scan_access, scan_business_card.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: compare, scan_business_card · Private data: contact_request, request_scan_access, scan_business_card · Public sink: contact_request, request_scan_access, scan_business_card

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
